aqi.interpretation: Interpolated CPCB AQI between real monitoring stations. Values between stations are estimates (IDW), not measurements; pixels > 15 km from stations are NoData.
aqi.methodology: OpenAQ v3 CPCB/MPCB stations → CPCB National AQI (2014) → IDW
aqi.nodata_semantics: transparent; fewer than 2 stations within 15 km, or outside study region
aqi.source: OpenAQ v3 (CPCB / MPCB continuous ambient monitoring stations)

composite.interpretation: 0 = low combined stress, 1 = high. Relative index for exploration, not a regulatory measure.
composite.methodology: Weighted environmental stress from real LST + NDVI + CPCB AQI
composite.nodata_semantics: transparent where any included input is missing (no imputation) or on open water (NDVI < 0)

lst.methodology: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 median composite LST

visualization.nodata_semantics: transparent; output alpha masked to valid pixels in the municipality union

qc.rule: pixels below this are probable residual cloud; hidden in display, excluded from cell stats

ndvi.interpretation: NDVI · Vegetation Signal — satellite-derived normalised difference vegetation index; higher NDVI indicates a stronger green-vegetation signal. Visualisation only uses multi-colour heatmap display; scientific pixel values in the GeoTIFF are unchanged.
ndvi.nodata_semantics: transparent; no valid cloud-masked satellite NDVI pixel; study region clipped to Mumbai + Thane + Mira-Bhayandar boundaries (visualisation layers only)

preprocessing.cloud_mask: project-established QA60-cloud filtering with cirrus exclusion

legend.gradient: magenta → red → orange → yellow → lime → green → teal

visualization.smoothing: normalised Gaussian on raw values, display only
visualization.transparent_semantics: NDVI < 0 (open water) and NoData are transparent

no2_s5p_column_retired.interpretation: Sentinel-5P NO2 column number density converted to an AQI proxy score (0-500).
no2_s5p_column_retired.nodata_semantics: transparent; no valid satellite AQI pixel; study region clipped to Mumbai + Thane + Mira-Bhayandar boundaries
no2_s5p_column_retired.retired_reason: Satellite NO2 column is not CPCB AQI; never served as AQI.

water_health.interpretation: Water body condition index 0..1; higher means healthier (less algal stress + less suspended-material stress averaged), computed only for pixels detected as water via MNDWI >= 0.15 and a 5-pixel 8-connected component filter. Visualisation uses percentile-based colour spread so that tightly-clustered values show distinct saturated heatmap colours; scientific pixel values in the GeoTIFF are unchanged.
water_health.nodata_semantics: transparent; non-water pixel / no valid Sentinel-2 observation; study region clipped to Mumbai + Thane + Mira-Bhayandar boundaries (visualisation layers only)

preprocessing.cloud_mask: project-established QA60-cloud filtering with cirrus exclusion

legend.note: Colours stretched between in-region p2 and p98 so close values separate; raw index unchanged.

visualization.smoothing: normalised Gaussian on raw values inside detected water, display only
